scope: Exact original allowlisted publicAPISpans subtree; raw unrecognized API messages were never retained. No successful full-sequence attribution inferred.

value.scope: Public Logger api-name lifecycle only; callback times in same Node clock as retained primary spans. No args/values/selectors/results are read. Public Logger is deprecated/incomplete: exact observed sequence is required and absence is not evidence of no internal retry.
limitations: Instrumentation adds overhead; no acceptance comparison or subtraction
Logs delimit public calls, not internal retry iterations, transport phases or actual renderer-ready time
Success means exact observed public sequence, not completeness of all internal Playwright work
Node offsets are never subtracted from browser performance or trace timestamps

failureCauseLimits: Later static smoke proves a possible background-callback mechanism, not which names caused these exact100 unknown messages.
